Download **bambu-deck-0.1.8.streamDeckPlugin** and double-click it; Stream Deck installs the plugin along with its profiles.

- "Steuern" and "Druckinfo" show the outline of your printer model: closed box (X1, X2D, P1, P2S), open frame (A1, A2L) or wide box (H2, H3C)
- Simple keys (pause, stop, light, speed, axes, filament, G-code, Steuern) carry a small bamboo mark, Bambu Deck's own sign
